blockers.note: func_800698D4 (0x5A0D4, 141 words): disc identification/mount. 140/141 words; all content words match, single residual. WHAT IT DOES (port-relevant): clears the mount flag, verifies drive ready, then searches the disc for \\FMV1\\PEDISC01.IDF;1, \\PE.IMG;1, \\FMV2\\PEDISC02.IDF;1 (+ PE.IMG again) via DsSearchFile, calling func_80080C48 on success, recording the result in D_800B0DD8 and setting flag bits in D_800B0DCD; returns 0 on any success, -2 if nothing mounted, error codes otherwise. PASSED: nested-if phrasing defeats gcc's range-test collapse (v1!=0 && v1!=-1 folds to addiu+sltiu+bnez under -O2; nested ifs keep separate compares). Short-circuit-AND wait loops, the three delay-slot error constants, addiu $a0,$sp,0x10 in jal delay slots, the mixed-sign byte (unsigned char + (signed char) cast at the return test), the sltiu/negu/and -2 return — ALL exact. FRAME NOTE: the DsSearchFile local is 0x18 (CdlFILE: pos 4 + size 4 + name 16), NOT 0x20 — 0x10 args + 0x18 local + $s0 + $ra = frame 0x30; a 0x20 local emits 0x38 and fails at word 0. RESIDUAL: one delay slot. Search #3's beqz at 0x5A24C — retail leaves the slot nop, ours steals the addiu $v0,$zero,-1. MECHANISM: the steal candidate is a $v0-setter. At #1/#2 the fail target (.L80069A04) hits a jal immediately, killing $v0 → steal accepted → both fill. At #3/#4 the fail target (.L80069ADC) computes the RETURN value, so $v0 is live to jr $ra → retail declines the steal → nop. Our cc1 steals anyway, so the divergence is in reorg.c's liveness/steal check (version skew ccpsx vs 2.7.2-psx), NOT source-expressible: neither the constant's register nor the fail-target location is source-controllable. FALSIFIABLE PREDICTION (screening rule): a beqz/beq with a nop slot + a $v0-constant load on the fall-through, branching to a RETURN block, will diverge this way; the same pattern branching to a jal-adjacent block will match. Test on future leaves. Closest candidate (nested-ifs, 140/141) stashed: 'park phase5fb func_800698D4 nested-ifs 140-141 (search3 beqz-slot residual)'.
